Aerie.name: Aerie
Aerie.description:
Each installed Raven Black ICE destroys Programs instead of derezzing.

No automation provided

Aerozep Selfsealing Gasbag.name: Aerozep Selfsealing Gasbag
Aerozep Selfsealing Gasbag.description:
Hardens an Aerozep's weakpoint and prevents any bonus damage from aimed shots.

Moto Rank Required: 7

Availability: Aerozep

Airhypo Bayonet.name: Airhypo Bayonet
Airhypo Bayonet.description:
A hypodermic syringe that can deliver 1 dose of any liquid compound to the target as if it were an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Th74cfC87RqEJKAb]{Airhypo}.

Requires 1 Action to reload

Ask Alex Anything.name: Ask Alex Anything
Ask Alex Anything.description:
Allows users to search for information on the CitiNet.

Pre-Installed on all @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{agents} by default.

BabelChat.name: BabelChat
BabelChat.description:
Allows users to send and receive text and video messages.

Pre-Installed on all @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{agents} by default.

BangMe!.name: BangMe!
BangMe!.description:
Online banking and peer to peer payment system.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Big SAAI.name: Big SAAI
Big SAAI.description:
Grants a +1 bonus to your agent's Library Search functions.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Bottle Dynamo.name: Bottle Dynamo
Bottle Dynamo.description:
A dynamo on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_vehicles.Item.XIDIqcWCFJtzYeRw]{bike's} wheel for converting mechanical energy into electricity. Can fully charge a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.MfuoJ69NL1FiP7B8]{battery pack} in one hour.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Brainwasher.name: Brainwasher
Brainwasher.description:
Provides basic therapy. Use for 1 week before receiving therapy, then roll [[/r 1d10 #Brainwasher Therapy]]

On even results: Therapy takes 1 less day to complete.

On odd results: Therapy takes 1 more day to complete.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Bulletproof Enclosure.name: Bulletproof Enclosure
Bulletproof Enclosure.description:
Your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_vehicles.Item.XIDIqcWCFJtzYeRw]{bicycle's} windows are now considered thin cover with 7 HP. Refer to the cover rules in CP:R, pg. 182.

Bike first requires the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.X3QvlINFBZtTGISU]{Enclosure} upgrade to install this upgrade.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Bushido Accelerator.name: Bushido Accelerator
Bushido Accelerator.description:
+3 Speed to all installed Killer Black ICE.

No automation provided — Requires manual program configuration.

Buzzsaw Arm.name: Buzzsaw Arm
Buzzsaw Arm.description:
Acts as a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.PxOjhUUs7cRULv75]{Very Heavy Melee Weapon}, choose location: Front, Rear, Side. A passenger must use their Action to extend or retract the arm.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 1 days

Salvage DV: 9

Construction Modifier: +1

Catapult.name: Catapult
Catapult.description:
A Heavy Weapon mounted on the roof that can launch any object the size of a person. Any individual launched by the catapult must make a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.body+@skills.athletics #DV15 Athletics]]{DV15 Athletics} check to land safely on the ground or the person takes [[/r 2d6dmg #Unsafe Landing]]{2d6 damage} directly to their HP.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 1 days

Salvage DV: 13

Construction Modifier: +1

Cockpit Glass.name: Cockpit Glass
Cockpit Glass.description:
All glass on the vehicle's cockpit is now considered cover with 30HP.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 3 days

Salvage DV: 15

Construction Modifier: +1

Cold-Weather Jacket Lining.name: Cold-Weather Jacket Lining
Cold-Weather Jacket Lining.description:
User will not suffer Exposure penalties from cold temperatures (CP:R pg 181).

Upgrade designed for use with any Jacket.

Combat Recorder.name: Combat Recorder
Combat Recorder.description:
Real-world Combat data is invaluable for Black ICE development.

If another Netrunner in the same NET Architecture fails a Death Save, the last 5 minutes of non-self incriminating Netrun combat data is saved to the Cyberdeck. Recordings can be sold for 50eb.

Combat Spikes.name: Combat Spikes
Combat Spikes.description:
Increases ramming damage by [[/r 2d6dmg #Bonus Ramming Damage]]{2d6} when boosted by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.n51IrwLux1v0fY78]{NOS}. Constructing this upgrade a second time increases the damage to [[/r 3d6dmg #Bonus Ramming Damage]]{3d6}

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 3 days

Salvage DV: 13

Construction Modifier: +1

Crunch Whistle.name: Crunch Whistle
Crunch Whistle.description:
Connects your cyberdeck to a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.VxgRZlqHqwv1TI3e]{Breacher}. When this upgrade is installed, a Netrunner may add their Interface Rank to the result when hacking an agent.

Provided AE must be manually updated to match the Netrunner's role ability.

Cuddlefish Outfit (Costly).name: Cuddlefish Outfit (Costly)
Cuddlefish Outfit (Costly).description: A cute outfit for your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_weapons.Item.hopvkkGSKLpKg4p7]{Captain Cuddlefish Ultra Snag-Em}! Prized by collectors.

Cuddlefish Outfit (Default).name: Cuddlefish Outfit (Default)
Cuddlefish Outfit (Default).description: A cute outfit for your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_weapons.Item.hopvkkGSKLpKg4p7]{Captain Cuddlefish Ultra Snag-Em}! Collect them all!

Cycle Armor.name: Cycle Armor
Cycle Armor.description:
A @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_vehicles.Item.XIDIqcWCFJtzYeRw]{Bicycle} armored with 7 SP.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle.

Requires: @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.zZYQHXJ96WQS8FAu]{Reinforced Frame}

Defense Sequencer.name: Defense Sequencer
Defense Sequencer.description: If an active @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_programs.Item.yommG7jwlXzoyf8Z]{Armor} is derezzed or destroyed, this upgrade activates a yet-unused copy of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_programs.Item.yommG7jwlXzoyf8Z]{Armor} at the start of your turn.

Electric Pedal Assist.name: Electric Pedal Assist
Electric Pedal Assist.description:
Electric motorized system helping to increase the bicycle's Speed (narrative) to the next BODY tier or adds 5MPH/8KPH to Speed (narrative) if already at the highest BODY tier.

Rider get +4 bonus to Endurance Checks to resisting exhaustion when riding.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle.

Elflines Online.name: Elflines Online
Elflines Online.description: A new in-box copy Elflines Online. Requires the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.FsrrwGv2ocZ1lQlE]{Segotari RUSH Revolution} to play.

Elflines Online Elftracker.name: Elflines Online Elftracker
Elflines Online Elftracker.description:
A companion app for @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.ucX1EbPnMOBUyvlB]{ELO} that allows users to track in-game stats and connect with other players.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Enclosure.name: Enclosure
Enclosure.description:
The bike becomes a trike with a covering body of fiberglass and plastic.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle.

Can't install this Upgrade with the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.BMtpB0IpvAp6xon8]{Folding Frame} upgrade.

Extended Seat.name: Extended Seat
Extended Seat.description:
An elongated saddle, gaining a seat for a passenger.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Extra AV-4 Engine.name: Extra AV-4 Engine
Extra AV-4 Engine.description:
An @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.g0ywfFzHeILd8KGd]{Extra AV-4 Engine} can be added for each @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.Z4CwN5KrhElqcU6O]{Extra Chassis} installed into your Punknaught Core.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 2 days

Salvage DV: 15

Construction Modifier: +2

Extra Chassis.name: Extra Chassis
Extra Chassis.description:
Only 3 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.Z4CwN5KrhElqcU6O]{Extra Chassis} can be installed onto a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_vehicles.Item.6CYGY3LJdRM9vjaI]{Punknaught Core}.

Each Extra Chassis increases ramming damage by [[/r 1d6dmg #Extra Ramming Damage]]{1d6}.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 3 days

Salvage DV: 13

Construction Modifier: +2

Feline Instinct.name: Feline Instinct
Feline Instinct.description:
If an installed Sabertooth Black ICE destroys a Program, that Sabertooth deals an extra [[/r 1d6dmg #Sabertooth Bonus Damage]]{1d6 damage} on each subsequent attack for the duration of the Netrun.

No automation provided

Folding Frame.name: Folding Frame
Folding Frame.description:
You can now fold your bike to the size of a large suitcase for easier transport and storage.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Incompatible with @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.X3QvlINFBZtTGISU]{Enclosure}, @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.zZYQHXJ96WQS8FAu]{Reinforced Frame}, or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.81qxDB83rnxGNjdK]{Smuggling Compartment} upgrades.

Grapple Gun Underbarrel.name: Grapple Gun Underbarrel
Grapple Gun Underbarrel.description: Mounts under any crossbow or shoulder arm. Functions like a standard @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.VrwVUEHuMCGjp8Fi].

Gun Mount.name: Gun Mount
Gun Mount.description:
A system to attach an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.QrQNdHTuEDxrfIxS]{Assault Rifle}, a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.nFXxinLVjYA06z1K]{Heavy SMG} or a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.PJhu6eY766OegZBo]{Shotgun} on the handlebars, along with a firing button.

Shoots only forwards. Mounting and detaching requires one Action.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Handprint Scanner.name: Handprint Scanner
Handprint Scanner.description:
Use your agent to scan a handprint by making a DV13 Criminology Check. Scanning a full handprint takes 3 rounds. 5 partial prints may be combined to create a full handprint.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Hangar.name: Hangar
Hangar.description:
Provides safe parking for another vehicle. May be installed multiple times.

Moto Rank Required: 7

Availability: Aerozep, Yacht

Hangry Hangry Dragon.name: Hangry Hangry Dragon
Hangry Hangry Dragon.description:
Everytime an installed Dragon Black ICE destroys a Program it regains full REZ.

No automation provided

Hot-Weather Jacket Lining.name: Hot-Weather Jacket Lining
Hot-Weather Jacket Lining.description:
User will not suffer Exposure penalties from hot temperatures (CP:R pg 181).

Upgrade designed for use with any Jacket.

HusTool.name: HusTool
HusTool.description:
Find odd jobs and get paid! Jobs take 30 minutes to complete and pay 10eb. Available jobs are determined by the GM, roll [[/r 1d10 #HusTool]]

  • On a 1: Factors outside of your control prevent you from finishing the errand.

    • You waste your time and don't get paid.

  • On a 10: The errand is completed, but you encounter trouble.

    • GM rolls on an appropriate encounter table.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Neon Lighting.name: Neon Lighting
Neon Lighting.description:
Fiber-optic lights on bike's frame and wheels that count as a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.VbMY2fs3im1sP2dJ]{Light Tattoo} when you are on or near the bike.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

NOS.name: NOS
NOS.description:
Boost the Punknaught's speed and gain an extra Move Action for one turn. May be installed multiple times. Each tank only provides one turn of boost.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 1 days

Salvage DV: 13

Construction Modifier: +2

Perfume Shoppe.name: Perfume Shoppe
Perfume Shoppe.description:
Skunk Black ICE will only take 1 option slot to install.

No automation provided — manually update the program

Punknaught Armor.name: Punknaught Armor
Punknaught Armor.description:
Provides SP13 armor to your Punknaught. Preem attacks made against your Punknaught ignore this armor unless this upgrade has been installed twice.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 1 days

Salvage DV: 13

Construction Modifier: +1

Reinforced Frame.name: Reinforced Frame
Reinforced Frame.description:
Bike is now more resistant: +5 SDP and rider can be BODY 11 or more.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Incompatible with the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.BMtpB0IpvAp6xon8]{Folding Frame} upgrade.

Reinforced Hull.name: Reinforced Hull
Reinforced Hull.description:
Hardens a vessel's hull and prevents any bonus damage from aimed shots.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Sea Vehicles

Reinforced Tires.name: Reinforced Tires
Reinforced Tires.description:
Hardens a vehicle's tires and prevents any bonus damage from aimed shots.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Land Vehicles

Retina Scanner.name: Retina Scanner
Retina Scanner.description:
Use your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent} to extract the retinal pattern from footage recorded by a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.clCxd7qkp2olsKii]{Video Camera} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.YzRXqhofQHcRcHFr]{MicroVideo} cybercam. Copying a retinal patern takes 5 rounds and may require a number of Brawling checks to restrain an unwilling subject.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Roach Race.name: Roach Race
Roach Race.description:
A retro sidescroller game from Poland.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Sealed Environment.name: Sealed Environment
Sealed Environment.description:
Protects occupants from breathing in any hazardous gasses from outside the vehicle.

Moto Rank Required: 1

Availability: All Vehicles

Security System.name: Security System
Security System.description:
Your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_vehicles.Item.XIDIqcWCFJtzYeRw]{Bike} is registered with a Nano-VIN linked to your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}. When secured, the bike is electrified to deter theft. A thief must roll a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs}. On a failure, the thief must unhand the bike.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Segotari Agent Game.name: Segotari Agent Game
Segotari Agent Game.description:
A game that uses the Self-Adaptive AI onboard your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent} to generate new levels or respond in real time to player input.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Segotari RUSH Game (Used).name: Segotari RUSH Game (Used)
Segotari RUSH Game (Used).description: A used virtual reality game formatted for the original @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.F6Tqc5Wja6rdkaNz]{RUSH } virtual reality headset.

Segotari RUSH Revolution Game.name: Segotari RUSH Revolution Game
Segotari RUSH Revolution Game.description: A virtual reality game formatted for the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.FsrrwGv2ocZ1lQlE]{RUSH Revolution} headset.

Shining Finger.name: Shining Finger
Shining Finger.description:
Access to a library of pornographic content that can be linked to various cyberware options. Charged monthly.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Silencer.name: Silencer
Silencer.description:
Greatly reduces the weapon's audio profile.

A Perception Check to determine the location of the gunshot may be rolled against a DV set by the GM.

Smithy.name: Smithy
Smithy.description: Be prepared for anything. Use Meat Action to change any and all installed @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_programs.Item.iHUrp2OkBZb3Ugf8]{Sword Programs} into @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_programs.Item.ccLHU1Ym4K4mnOds]{Banhammer Programs} or vice versa.

Smuggling Compartment.name: Smuggling Compartment
Smuggling Compartment.description:
Adds a small hidden storage space in the frame that requires a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.int+@skills.concealOrRevealObject #DV17 Conceal/Reveal Object]]{DV17 Conceal/Reveal Object} check to discover.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Incompatible with the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_upgrades.Item.BMtpB0IpvAp6xon8]{Folding Frame} upgrade.

Snaketrap.name: Snaketrap
Snaketrap.description: Protects against the first attack (Asp, Raven, or Poison Flatline effects) that would destroy a random installed Program. This protective effect can be use only once per Netrun even if multiple copies of this upgrade are installed.

Spike Strip Launcher.name: Spike Strip Launcher
Spike Strip Launcher.description:
This Heavy Weapon launches a coil of metal spikes from the rear of your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_vehicles.Item.6CYGY3LJdRM9vjaI]{Punknaught}. Drivers following behind you must make a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.ref+@skills.driveLandVehicle #DV17 Drive Land Vehicle]]{DV17 Drive Land Vehicle} check to avoid [[/r 4d6dmg #4d6 Weak Point Damage]]{4d6} weak point damage.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 1 days

Salvage DV: 9

Construction Modifier: +1

Stun Bayonet.name: Stun Bayonet
Stun Bayonet.description: Equips the gun with a non-lethal melee weapon. Target is knocked unconscious if damage dealt would reduce them to under 1 HP. Doesn't cause Critical Injuries or ablate armor.

Stunt Frame.name: Stunt Frame
Stunt Frame.description:
The bike loses weight and gains maneuverability. Rider obtain a +2 bonus to Athletics skill checks when riding and doing maneuvers.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Submersible Upgrade.name: Submersible Upgrade
Submersible Upgrade.description:
Driver may use Pilot Sea Vehicle to navigate underwater at MOVE 20.

Moto Rank Required: 5

Availability: All Land and Sea Vehicles except Bikes and Jetskis

Swamp Mist.name: Swamp Mist
Swamp Mist.description:
Wisp Black ICE deal 2d6 damage instead of 1d6. Black ICE Program restrictions: Only Wisps can be installed.

No automation provided — manually update any installed Wisp Programs

Swifty Clean.name: Swifty Clean
Swifty Clean.description: A Netrunner can roll Cloak twice in a single NET Action and take the higher roll. Cloak can only be used once per Netrun when this upgrade is installed.

The Garden.name: The Garden
The Garden.description:
A free social media platform hosted by Ziggurat. Users require an account to comment or publish content.

Find love in The Garden! @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_macros.Macro.3n77kf9lHNb2dFY3]{See who you match with!}

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Titanic Hull (13+ Rooms).name: Titanic Hull (13+ Rooms)
Titanic Hull (13+ Rooms).description:
Increase SDP for vehicles with 13+ rooms.

Moto Rank Required: 7

Availability: Aerozep, Yacht

Titanic Hull (1-4 Rooms).name: Titanic Hull (1-4 Rooms)
Titanic Hull (1-4 Rooms).description:
Increase SDP for vehicles with 1-4 rooms.

Moto Rank Required: 7

Availability: Aerozep, Yacht

Titanic Hull (5-8 Rooms).name: Titanic Hull (5-8 Rooms)
Titanic Hull (5-8 Rooms).description:
Increase SDP for vehicles with 5-8 rooms.

Moto Rank Required: 7

Availability: Aerozep, Yacht

Titanic Hull (9-12 Rooms).name: Titanic Hull (9-12 Rooms)
Titanic Hull (9-12 Rooms).description:
Increase SDP for vehicles with 9-12 rooms.

Moto Rank Required: 7

Availability: Aerozep, Yacht

Trailer.name: Trailer
Trailer.description:
Hook with a small cargo trailer. An action is needed to attach and detach the trailer.

Moto Rank Required: N/A

Availability: Bicycle

Turret.name: Turret
Turret.description:
Adds a swivel mount that can support any 2-handed ranged weapon you already own. This upgrade may be constructed 3 times for each chassis installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_vehicles.Item.6CYGY3LJdRM9vjaI]{Punknaught}. A passenger riding the Punknaught may use their Action to fire or reload the weapon.

Availability: Punknaught

Construction Time: 1 days

Salvage DV: 13

Construction Modifier: +1

Vehicle Room (Complex).description:
Each room provides the vehicle with additional seating and ample space for specialized purpose.

Each room provides the vehicle with Luxury seating.

WatchBox.name: WatchBox
WatchBox.description:
Turns your agent into an alarm system. Requires 5 minutes to scan and establish a security perimeter. The alarm is triggered by loud noises, bright lights, and movement. Avoid detection with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.dex+@skills.stealth #DV13 Stealth]]{DV13 Stealth} check.

Install this App on your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}

Waterproof Jacket Lining.name: Waterproof Jacket Lining
Waterproof Jacket Lining.description:
Mechanically similar to an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_gear.Item.qLpYhxmPD1u2lMG8]{umbrella}, does not serve as a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_armor.Item.XlpdmDjdNH9uzhq8]{Dry Suit}.

Protects against @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_weather-effects.Item.yd5RKbg33WnbwKAE]{Acid Rain} and provides +2 to Resist Torture/Drugs Checks from @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.dlc_weather-effects.Item.SKqisyIQrtc6AOd1]{Blood Rain} exposure.

Upgrade designed for use with any Jacket.

ZPost.name: ZPost
ZPost.description:
Allows users to organize, send, and receive emails.

Pre-Installed on all @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{agents} by default.
